pck_android_mb.note: D-99 (owner 2026-11-08: quality first, the game ships on Google Play): pck up to the Play base-module headroom. AAB ~= pck + ~11-20 MB. Content beyond that goes into downloadable packs (voice packs D-62, later job/arrival packs).

aab_release_mb.note: D-99: Play base module limit is 200 MB (compressed download); keep 2 MB margin. Larger content -> downloadable packs, not the base module.

startup_headless_s.note: median of 5: engine init + autoloads + boot scene + 5 frames, CI runner

lock_scene_headless_s.note: median of 3: plan B lock scene + 5 frames

startup_rss_mb.note: peak RSS of the headless boot (no GPU); proxy for leaks/oversized resources
